name: Vera 05 · 10 Read and check a paper

parameters.content:
## Vera 05 · 10 Read and check a paper
A paper filed by a button tap (sender or reviewer) has not been read yet. This reads it from the bucket and runs the same paper checks as WF-02, so no paper is accepted without them.

Generated from `n8n/mobilise/workflows.mjs`. Edit there and rebuild; edits made here are overwritten on the next import.
Each node's note says what it does and which guardrails it carries.

nodes.name: Paper filed by a button
nodes.notes: From WF-02 after a confirm or review answer.

nodes.name: Load the paper

parameters.query:
select e.id as evidence_id, e.mobilisation_id, e.s3_key, e.mime, e.created_by as contact_id, e.message_id, row_to_json(mo) as mob,
  json_build_object('code', l.code, 'text', l.text, 'docType', l.doc_type, 'rules', l.rules, 'evidence', l.evidence) as line,
  json_build_object('line', l.code, 'method', e.bind_method) as binding,
  json_build_object('type', case when e.kind = 'document' then 'document' else 'image' end) as message
from evidence e join mobilisations mo on mo.id = e.mobilisation_id join lines l on l.mobilisation_id = e.mobilisation_id and l.code = e.line_code
where e.id = $1 and e.s3_key is not null;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [($json.evidence_id) ?? null, (JSON.stringify($json.fields || null)) ?? null, (JSON.stringify(($json.paper || {}).checks || null)) ?? null, (($json.paper || {}).status || 'review') ?? null, ($json.fragment.reason) ?? null, (($json.paper || {}).expires_on || '') ?? null] }}

nodes.notes:
Checks on the evidence, status on the line, a review item if a person must look. Never overwrites the engineer's decision.
Guardrails: audit, retry

nodes.name: Queue the reply

parameters.query: insert into reply_queue (mobilisation_id, contact_id, fragment) values ($1, $2, $3::jsonb) returning id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [($('Make reply fragment').item.json.mobilisation_id) ?? null, ($('Make reply fragment').item.json.contact_id) ?? null, (JSON.stringify($('Make reply fragment').item.json.fragment)) ?? null] }}

nodes.notes:
Goes out with the next burst reply (WF-05).
Guardrails: retry

nodes.name: Send to review queue

parameters.query: insert into review_queue (mobilisation_id, evidence_id, reason) select mobilisation_id, id, 'Could not re-read the paper: ' || $2 from evidence where id = $1 returning id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [($('Paper filed by a button').item.json.evidence_id) ?? null, (($json.error && $json.error.message) || 'step failed') ?? null] }}

nodes.notes:
Bucket or AI failed: a person checks the paper. It stays filed on its line.
Guardrails: human
